_doc: cp#533. Repo Actions variables whose VALUE is declared here, so a change is a PR with a diff. scripts/check-declared-vars.mjs runs in deploy.yml and refuses a deploy when a live variable and its declaration disagree. Change both together: this file in a PR, then the variable. Never put a secret here.
